page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.6xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. It features 24 physical cores and 24 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing the KVM hypervisor. The system is equipped with 96.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the average tier across several workloads. It achieves a single-core stress-ng score of 1438.39 and a multi-core score of 23015.19. Memory bandwidth tests show read-only cached performance at 1282.13 GB/sec and uncached large-block writes at 48.03 GB/sec. In application-specific tests, the instance processes 22.14 million Redis SET operations per second and delivers a static web serving throughput of 17.13 GB/sec. For lightweight machine learning, it handles 7B model prompt processing at 34.44 tokens per second.

Lacking local NVMe storage and GPU accelerators, the ecs.hfg6.6xlarge is not designed for heavy storage-bound databases or large-scale deep learning training. However, its dedicated CPU allocation and high clock speed make it highly cost-efficient for compute-intensive tasks that fit within its 96.0 GB memory envelope. It is well-suited for workloads such as web serving, software compilation, text processing, and medium-scale database operations.
